intro.title: Company Information & Legal Notice (Detailed)
intro.body: This page summarizes the operator details, nature of the service, and data handling practices of JOBSAPO in accordance with relevant Japanese laws and common compliance requirements for job-matching platforms.

companyProfile.title: Company Profile
companyProfile.companyName: Company Name: Global Network Innovation Co., Ltd.
companyProfile.address: Address: Fukaya Building 5-A, 4-22-10 Koto, Sumida-ku, Tokyo 130-0014, Japan
companyProfile.business: Business: Human Resources Services / IT Services

provides.title: What JOBSAPO Provides
provides.body: JOBSAPO is a web platform that provides job and candidate information and matching opportunities between employers and job seekers.

notParty.title: Not a Party to Employment Contracts
notParty.body: The Company is not a party to employment contracts between employers and job seekers. Employment conditions and hiring decisions are determined by employers, and users act at their own responsibility.

fees.title: Placement Fees (Current Status)
fees.body:
At present, the Company does not charge or receive any placement fees or success-based commissions from employers or job seekers through JOBSAPO.

In the future, if JOBSAPO is operated as a licensed paid employment placement service, additional disclosures such as license number, fee table, and complaint handling may be added after obtaining the required license.

points.item1: False, misleading, or illegal job postings are prohibited.
points.item2: Discriminatory expressions that may violate laws and regulations are not allowed.
points.item3: The Company may review, request corrections, or remove listings when necessary.

compliance.title: Compliance & Prohibited Conduct
compliance.lead: Users must not engage in the following:

items.item1: Posting or registering false or inaccurate information
items.item2: Posting content that may violate Japanese laws (employment-related, immigration-related, etc.)
items.item3: Acts against public order and morals, or involvement with antisocial forces
items.item4: Infringing third-party rights (copyright, trademark, privacy, etc.)
items.item5: Unauthorized access, excessive load, scraping, or any disruption to the service

items.item1: Name and contact details (phone, email, etc.)
items.item2: Address, education, work history, qualifications, desired job/location
items.item3: Nationality and date of birth; optional immigration-related self-declared information
items.item4: Device data, access logs, IP address, cookies and identifiers

items.item2: User management, identity verification, fraud prevention

sharing.title: Sharing with Third Parties
sharing.body: We may share necessary user data with employers and related parties for matching purposes. We do not provide personal data to third parties without consent unless required by law.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We retain personal data only for the period necessary to achieve the purposes of use or as required by law.

requests.title: Requests by Users
requests.body: Users may request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of use of their personal data in accordance with applicable laws.

security.title: Security Measures
security.lead: We implement reasonable security measures to protect personal data, including:

items.item3: Logging, monitoring, and anti-unauthorized access measures
items.item4: Vendor oversight for outsourced processing (including cloud services)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We may use cookies and similar technologies to improve usability and analyze usage. Users can disable cookies in browser settings, but some functions may not work properly.

warranty.title: No Warranty
warranty.body: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, legality, or timeliness of information provided on this service.

damages.title: Disputes and Damages
damages.body: We are not liable for any disputes or damages arising from the use of this service, including hiring cancellations, mismatched conditions, or labor-related issues.

suspension.title: Service Suspension
suspension.body: We may suspend or interrupt the service due to maintenance, system failures, disasters, or other unavoidable reasons.
